years.1996: Established in the economic capital of Syria, Aleppo, under the name Aleppo Printing, specializing in flexographic and rotogravure technologies.
years.2013: Manufacturing activity transferred to Egypt (Borg El Arab, Alexandria), rebranding as Roto Star to serve a broader international market.
years.today: Delivering high-performance Rotogravure solutions across all substrates (BOPP, PE, PET, Alu, Paper) in single and multi-layer structures.

hero.subtitle: ABOUT ROTO STAR
hero.title: Built on Trust. Driven by Innovation.
hero.description: From Aleppo to Alexandria, our journey is rooted in quality, innovation, and a passion for packaging excellence that spans over three decades.
